entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A ronin who tries to avoid the conflict between spirits and humans but ends up at its center; teleports using shadow powers and is ultimately blinded and left on Madara.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Daughter of Daimyo Konda, living with the kitsune in Jukai and tied to the Taken One.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Daimyo and father of Michiko, who commands a ghost army and is turned to stone and shattered by the sisters.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The spirit sealed in the disc, freed by Michiko and named Kyodai by Toshi, meaning sibling.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A spirit goddess who grants Toshi shadow powers and forbids him to teleport the Taken One through her realm.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre of the Hyozan Reckoners who wants Toshi's full commitment; later becomes the new chaos oni.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: Sole survivor of her wizarding clan, infused with shadow powers that drive her insane.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: A nezumi rat who joins Toshi and is killed by the hyozan oath.

entities.name: All-Consuming Oni of Chaos
entities.description: A manifestation of the god of chaos that eats the Minamo library and flees from O-Kagachi.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: An eight-headed spirit god whose heads are bitten off by the sisters; the sisters take his place in Kamigawa's cosmology.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: A soratami who uses the Kami War to conquer and remake the world in his image and is eaten by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Moonfolk who conquer in the Takenuma and Jukai during the Kami War.

entities.name: Captain Nagao
entities.description: Captain trapped at Minamo with his surviving men, later teleported to Jukai.

entities.name: Isamaru
entities.description: Attacks Toshi at Eiganjo and is teleported to Jukai.

entities.name: Sosuke
entities.description: Orochi leader who briefly captures Toshi.

entities.name: Jugan
entities.description: A dragon spirit the orochi summon to fight the soratami.

entities.name: Uyo
entities.description: Sends Toshi guilt-inducing dreams and is frozen to death by him.

entities.name: Chiyo
entities.description: Sends Toshi dreams and later mortally wounds him, wearing a mask after being mauled.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: Appears in Toshi's dreams telling him to deal with the Yuki-Onna.

entities.name: Yuki-Onna
entities.description: A spirit ravaging the Sokenzan mountain borderlands, whose power Toshi reclaims.

entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: A hyozan whose death Mochi was responsible for.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Missing after the fall of Eiganjo.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: Ogre faction bound by an oath that Toshi has left.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The great conflict between the spirit and human realms.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of the story.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest where the kitsune live and where Michiko stays.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: School whose library is being eaten by the oni.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: A fallen palace/fortress where Toshi steals a giant moth.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane to which Night's Reach teleports Toshi via a newly opened line.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where Toshi is left blind with a nearby swamp.

events.summary: Michiko sends a kanji message to Toshi; Eiganjo has fallen and the soratami are conquering in Takenuma and Jukai.
events.quote: Eiganjo has fallen, Takeshi Konda is missing, and the soratami are conquering in the Takenuma and Jukai.

events.summary: Toshi finds the oni eating Minamo's library and meets Hidetsugu, who wants his full commitment to the Hyozan Reckoners; Toshi refuses and they become enemies.
Toshi finds Kiku, sole survivor of her clan, helps control her shadow powers, and recruits Marrow-Gnawer.
events.quote: He finds Kiku as the sole survivor of her wizarding clan.

events.summary: Isamaru attacks Toshi at Eiganjo and Toshi teleports him to Jukai.
Toshi uses Night's Reach's powers to chase off the Oni of Chaos at Minamo, drawing Hidetsugu's ire as Konda's ghost army attacks.
events.quote: Luckily at that moment Konda and his ghost army attack Minamo

events.summary: Hidetsugu reveals the oath kills any who kill without drawing blood and chokes Kiku and Toshi; Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu in the eyes, bringing the oath's wrath on himself.
events.quote: he saves Toshi and Kiku by stabbing Hidetsugu in the eyes

events.summary: O-Kagachi appears; the Oni of Chaos flees, breaking Hidetsugu's spirit, and Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer.
Toshi is briefly captured by orochi led by Sosuke, and then tormented by dreams from Uyo and Chiyo confronting him with his misdeeds.
The Myojin reveals Toshi is being manipulated; he reclaims the Yuki-Onna's power and freezes Uyo solid, killing her.
Konda arrives at Jukai and the Taken One summons O-Kagachi; Toshi teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm against her command.
events.quote: he teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm

events.summary: Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who is named Kyodai; O-Kagachi manifests all eight heads.
Michiko and Kyodai merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads; Konda is turned to stone and shattered.
events.quote: Konda then shows up but is quickly turned to stone and shattered

events.summary: The sisters take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology and plan a blending of the two worlds.
events.quote: The sisters then take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology.

events.summary: Kyodai summons Hidetsugu, now the new chaos oni, who eats Mochi.
Chiyo mortally wounds Toshi; Night's Reach saves and teleports him to Dominaria, blinding him on Madara.
events.quote: She drops off Toshi on Madara and blinds him.

relations.quote: Princess Michiko , daughter of Daimyo Konda

relations.note: Merge as sisters to fight O-Kagachi.
relations.quote: The two sisters merge and return armed to face the still slowly descending O-Kagachi.
Toshi uses the powers granted to him by Night's Reach
the sisters shrinking O-Kagachi and biting off his remaining two heads
He is mortally wounded by Chiyo
he saves Toshi and Kiku by stabbing Hidetsugu in the eyes
